meta.title: Services — Australia Construction Consultants & Associates
meta.description: Contract advisory, risk management, feasibility, estimating, compliance, and client-side project management. Senior-level engagements across Australia.

intro.headline: Six services. Senior-level. Client-side.
intro.lede: ACCA acts for the owner, developer, or principal — never for the builder. Every engagement is scoped in writing before we start.

items.name: Contract Advisory
items.trigger: Before the contract is signed — and every time it moves.
items.what: Contract review and negotiation support under AS 4000, AS 4902, AS 2124, GC21, and bespoke forms. Ongoing administration once signed — RFIs, variations, extension-of-time assessments, progress claims, notices, and correspondence.
items.when: You need the contract paperwork run by a firm that has argued both sides of the same disputes and knows where each form breaks.
items.deliverable: Written contract review, negotiated special conditions, and — where the engagement continues into delivery — monthly reporting and a complete document register at practical completion.

items.name: Risk Management
items.what: Project risk register development and maintenance, quality-plan review, ITP (inspection & test plan) audits during construction, non-conformance tracking, and defect-prevention advice. Site quality audits on request.
items.when: You want an independent set of eyes on quality and risk — separate from the builder's own QA — either continuously or at defined milestones.
items.deliverable: Live risk register, quality audit reports, ITP register review, and non-conformance summaries with recommended actions.

items.name: Feasibility
items.what: Pre-commitment feasibility: site constraints, cost planning to elemental level, indicative programme, and a risk register you can hand to a board or a bank. Benchmarked against comparable completed projects.
items.when: You are about to seek finance, land at auction, or trigger a stage-two commitment, and the numbers in front of you have not yet been independently tested.
items.deliverable: Written feasibility report, cost plan, risk register, one revision, and presentation to your board or lender.

items.name: Estimating
items.what: Independent cost estimates at any stage — order-of-magnitude, elemental, trade-level, or bill of quantities. Tender price analysis, variation cost checks, and progress-claim assessment against the contract sum.
items.when: You need a cost check that is not the builder's, and not a headline number from a spreadsheet you cannot audit.
items.deliverable: Priced estimate with rate build-ups, assumptions register, and a written commentary on the drivers of the number.

items.name: Compliance
items.trigger: The rules that decide whether the project completes.
items.what: Compliance advisory across the NCC / BCA, planning conditions, WHS obligations, and contract-specified standards. Design-stage review, construction-stage audits, and defect-and-compliance reports at practical completion.
items.when: You need to know whether what is being built matches what was approved — and whether the paperwork will survive the certifier.
items.deliverable: Compliance review report, non-conformance schedule, and a close-out summary against each authority condition.

items.name: Project Management
items.trigger: End-to-end, on the owner's side of the table.
items.what: Client-side project management from initial planning through to handover. Programme oversight, cost tracking, consultant coordination, principal reporting, and stakeholder management across the full project lifecycle. Superintendent role under AS 4000 / AS 4902 where required.
items.when: You need a single project manager accountable to you — not the builder — running the project as an extension of your own team.
items.deliverable: Weekly progress reporting, monthly cost and programme dashboards, risk register maintained live, and a complete document register at handover.
